verdict.rationale: Adyen documents managing payment terminals and transactions from a unified Customer Area, ordering terminals for delivery to a chosen location via the Management API, and changing payout settings per merchant account. This implies a multi-location fleet structure, but per-location device assignment, settings and reporting are never explicitly described. Missing for 10: explicit per-store/location hierarchy for devices, per-location terminal settings configuration, per-location reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
